book.name: SVUN MARCOS
book.title: LI'I JA' SC'OPLAL CAJVALTIC JESUCRISTO TS'IBABIL COMEL YU'UN MARCOS

content: Ja' smelol c'alal icha'cuxi li Jesuse

C'alal ech'em xa'ox li sc'ac'alil ta jcux co'ntoncutique, la smanic muil poxil li María ti liquem tal ta Magdalae, xchi'uc Salomé, xchi'uc li yan María sme' Jacovoe, yu'un chbat yac'beic ta sbec'tal li Jesuse.
Ta sob ta sliquebal semana, ja' li domingoe, ibatic yo' bu vombil tone. Loq'uem xa'ox c'ac'al.
Jech laj yalbe sbaic: ―¿Boch'o chixbalch'unbutic loq'uel tana li ton tey ta ti' ch'ene? ―xut sbaic.
Yu'un toj muc' li ton smacojic o ti' ch'ene. C'alal ic'otique, ja' to laj yilic ti balch'unbil xa loq'uel li tone.

C'alal i'ochic ta yut vombil tone, laj yilic oy boch'o tey oy xco'laj xchi'uc jun sva'lej querem laj yilic. Tey chotol ta stuq'uil sbats'ic'obic. Natil saquil c'u'il slapoj. Toj xi'el ic'otic li antsetique.

Li quereme jech laj yalbe li antsetique: ―Mu me xaxi'ic. Ta jna' ti ja' chasa'ic li Jesús liquem tal ta Nazarete, ja' ti imilat ta cruze. Pero icha'cuxi xa. Mu'yuc xa li'i. Q'uelavilic li yav bu laj to'ox yaq'uique.
Bat me albeic Pedro xchi'uc yan yajchanc'optac ti ja' ba'yuc ta xc'ot yu'unic ta Galileae. Ja' to tey ta xc'ot yilic jech chac c'u cha'al albilic ono'oxe ―x'utatic batel li antsetique.
Li antsetique ixi'ic loq'uel ta yut li vombil tone, ibatic ta anil. Xt'elajetic xa batel ta xi'el. Mu'yuc boch'o laj yalbeic batel ta be yu'un ixi'ic.
Ja' smelol c'alal laj yac' sba ta ilel Jesús ta stojol li María liquem tal ta Magdalae
C'alal icha'cuxi Jesús ta sob ta sliquebal semanae, ba'yuc laj yac' sba ta ilel ta stojol li María liquem tal ta Magdalae. Ja' ti iloq'uesbat vucub pucuj ta yo'ntone.
Ibat li Maríae, bat yalbe ya'yic yajchanc'optac ti icha'cuxi xa li Jesuse. Li yajchanc'optac Jesuse tey chat yo'ntonic ch‑oq'uic c'ot taaticuc yu'un li Maríae.
C'alal laj ya'yic ti cha'cuxem xa li Jesuse xchi'uc ti laj xa yil li Maríae, muc xch'unic.
Ja' smelol c'alal laj yac' sba ta ilel Jesús ta stojol chib jch'unolajel
Ts'acal to laj yac' sba ta ilel Jesús ta stojol chib jch'unolajel tey chanovic ta be. Sc'atajesoj sat li Jesuse jech muc xotquinic ta ora.
Li chibique isutic ta Jerusalén, bat yalbe ya'yic li yantique pero muc xch'unbatic ec.
Ja' smelol c'alal laj yalbe comel c'usi yabtelic li buluchib yajchanc'optac Jesuse

Ts'acal to laj yac' sba ta ilel Jesús ta stojol buluchib yajchanc'optac ti c'alal ja' o ta xve'ique. Itaq'uiatic ta sventa ti muc xch'unique xchi'uc ta scoj ti tsots yo'ntonique. Yu'un muc xch'unic c'usi laj yalic li boch'otic laj yilic ti cha'cuxem xa li Jesuse.
Jech i'albatic yu'un li Jesuse: ―Batanic ta scotol banamil. Cholbeic scotol cristianoetic ti ja' no'ox chcolic ta jventae.
Scotol boch'o ta xch'unic ti chcolic ta jventae xchi'uc ti chich'ic vo'e ja' chcolic. Yan li boch'otic mu xch'unique ja' ta x'ac'batic castigo yu'un smulic.
Li boch'otic ta xch'unique ta spasic sq'uelubiltac jtsatsal. Ta sloq'uesic pucujetic ta yo'nton cristianoetic ta jvu'el. Ta xc'opojic ta ora no'ox ta yantic c'opetic.
Ac'o me ta xti'atic ta orachon, o me ta ts'inte', ac'o me oy ta x'ac'bat yuch'ic veneno, mu'yuc c'usi ta spasbatic. Ta xac' sc'obic ta sbec'tal jchameletic, ta xcol yu'unic ―x'utatic yu'un li Jesuse.
Ja' smelol c'alal itoy batel ta vinajel li Jesuse
C'alal ilaj yo'nton ta sc'opanel yajchanc'optac li Cajvaltique, i'ic'at muyel ta vinajel. Tey c'ot chotluc ta sbats'ic'ob Dios.

Li yajchanc'optaque iloc' xcholic ta scotol banamil ti ja' no'ox chijcol ta sventa Cajvaltique. Tey xchi'inojic ta abtel li Cajvaltique. Jech i'ac'bat spasic sq'uelubiltac yu'un ac'o vinajuc ti ta melel ja' sc'op ta xcholique.
